description: This file defines the PartialEmployeeAttachment class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing partial information about employee attachments in the OrangeHRM system, including metadata such as ID, filename, size, type, creator, and associated timestamps.

classes.name: PartialEmployeeAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object encapsulating partial details about an employee attachment, including file metadata and associated timestamps, with methods to access these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing attachment properties including ID, description, filename, size, type, creator info, and timestamps, converting DateTime to formatted strings.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the file was attached.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the file was attached.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the attached time in string format using the provided DateTime object.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attached date in string format using the provided DateTime object.
